D.tier: Queued, roster and office levers only

D.t: Chellie Pingree leads by 26.5 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 102,192 votes; a one point swing is about 1,930 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +17.9 and D +34.8. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$365K cash against $19K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
Registered Democrats cast 50% of the 179,532 ballots in Maine so far, against 21% for the other party. That is 2.2 points better for Democrats than the forecast expected by now.

D.h: What the ballots so far say
D.t: The early vote has moved this forecast 0.3 points toward Chellie Pingree. Bank it: chase the remaining mail ballots and low propensity voters who have not voted.
Money: Raised $192K against $531K for Chellie Pingree.

R.t: Ron Russell trails by 26.5 and wins 0% of simulations. Closing it takes about 51,096 voters switching sides, or 102,192 more net votes from new turnout.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +34.8 and D +17.9. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$19K cash against $365K. Outspent: lean on earned media, digital, field and the outside groups, and pick the two or three media markets that decide it.
Registered Republicans cast 21% of the 179,532 ballots in Maine so far, against 50% for the other party. That is 2.2 points worse for Republicans than the forecast expected by now.
